## Essential Formulas ### Degree and Distribution | Metric | Formula | Description | |--------|---------|-------------| | **Degree** | $k_i = \sum_j A_{ij}$ | Number of connections for node i | | **Average Degree** | $\langle k \rangle = \frac{1}{N}\sum_i k_i = \frac{2E}{N}$ | Mean degree in network | | **Degree Distribution** | $P(k)$ | Probability of degree k | | **Power Law** | $P(k) \sim k^{-\gamma}$ | Scale-free distribution | | **Exponential** | $P(k) \sim e^{-k/\kappa}$ | Exponential decay | ### Clustering and Triangles | Metric | Formula | Description | |--------|---------|-------------| | **Clustering Coefficient (node)** | $C_i = \frac{\sum_{j,m} A_{ij}A_{jm}A_{mi}}{k_i(k_i-1)}$ | Local clustering | | **Average Clustering** | $\langle C \rangle = \frac{1}{N}\sum_i C_i$ | Network clustering | | **Transitivity** | $T = \frac{3 \times \text{triangles}}{\text{connected triplets}}$ | Global clustering | | **Weighted Clustering** | $C_w(i) = \frac{1}{s_i(k_i-1)}\sum_{j,h}\frac{w_{ij}+w_{ih}}{2}A_{ij}A_{ih}A_{jh}$ | For weighted networks | ### Centrality Metrics | Metric | Formula | Description | Complexity | |--------|---------|-------------|------------| | **Degree Centrality** | $C_D(i) = \frac{k_i}{N-1}$ | Normalized degree | O(1) | | **Betweenness** | $C_B(i) = \sum_{s \neq i \neq t} \frac{\sigma_{st}(i)}{\sigma_{st}}$ | Shortest paths through i | O(NE) | | **Closeness** | $C_C(i) = \frac{N-1}{\sum_j d_{ij}}$ | Inverse average distance | O(N²) | | **Eigenvector** | $C_E(i) = \frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_j A_{ij}C_E(j)$ | Recursive importance | O(N²) | | **PageRank** | $PR(i) = \frac{1-d}{N} + d\sum_j \frac{PR(j)}{k_j^{out}}A_{ji}$ | Web ranking | O(E) | | **Katz Centrality** | $C_K(i) = \sum_{k=1}^{\infty}\sum_j \alpha^k A_{ij}^k$ | Attenuated paths | O(N³) | ### Path and Distance Metrics | Metric | Formula | Description | |--------|---------|-------------| | **Shortest Path** | $d_{ij} = \min(\text{path length})$ | Minimum hops between i,j | | **Average Path Length** | $\langle d \rangle = \frac{1}{N(N-1)}\sum_{i \neq j} d_{ij}$ | Mean distance | | **Diameter** | $d_{max} = \max_{i,j} d_{ij}$ | Maximum distance | | **Efficiency** | $E = \frac{1}{N(N-1)}\sum_{i \neq j} \frac{1}{d_{ij}}$ | Inverse distances | ### Community Detection | Metric | Formula | Description | |--------|---------|-------------| | **Modularity** | $Q = \frac{1}{2E}\sum_{ij}[A_{ij} - \frac{k_ik_j}{2E}]\delta(c_i,c_j)$ | Community quality | | **Conductance** | $\phi(S) = \frac{cut(S,\bar{S})}{\min(vol(S),vol(\bar{S}))}$ | Cut quality | | **Coverage** | $\text{Cov} = \frac{\sum_c E_c}{E}$ | Intra-community edges | | **Participation Coef** | $P_i = 1 - \sum_s (\frac{k_{is}}{k_i})^2$ | Multi-community nodes | ## Epidemic Models ### Basic Models | Model | Transitions | Equations | Threshold | |-------|------------|-----------|-----------| | **SI** | S → I | $\frac{dI}{dt} = \beta SI$ | None | | **SIS** | S ⇄ I | $\frac{dI}{dt} = \beta SI - \gamma I$ | $R_0 = \beta/\gamma > 1$ | | **SIR** | S → I → R | $\frac{dS}{dt} = -\beta SI$
$\frac{dI}{dt} = \beta SI - \gamma I$ | $R_0 = \beta/\gamma > 1$ | | **SEIR** | S → E → I → R | Includes exposed period | $R_0 > 1$ | ### Network Epidemics | Property | Formula | Description | |----------|---------|-------------| | **Basic Reproductive Number** | $R_0 = \beta \langle k \rangle / \gamma$ | Average infections | | **Epidemic Threshold (homogeneous)** | $\lambda_c = \frac{1}{\langle k \rangle}$ | Critical transmission | | **Epidemic Threshold (scale-free)** | $\lambda_c = \frac{\langle k \rangle}{\langle k^2 \rangle} \approx 0$ | Vanishing threshold | | **Herd Immunity** | $f > 1 - \frac{1}{R_0}$ | Fraction to immunize | ## Network Models ### Random Graph Models | Model | Properties | Degree Distribution | Clustering | |-------|------------|-------------------|------------| | **Erdős-Rényi G(n,p)** | Random edges | Poisson/Normal | Low: C ~ p | | **Configuration** | Fixed degrees | Prescribed | Low | | **Watts-Strogatz** | Small world | Regular → Random | Tunable high | | **Barabási-Albert** | Preferential attachment | Power law: $P(k) \sim k^{-3}$ | Low | ### Model Parameters | Model | Key Parameters | Generation Rule | |-------|---------------|-----------------| | **ER Random** | n nodes, p probability | Each edge with prob p | | **WS Small World** | n, k neighbors, p rewire | Ring + random rewiring | | **BA Scale-free** | n, m edges per node | Preferential: $\Pi(k) \sim k$ | | **Configuration** | Degree sequence {k_i} | Match stubs randomly | ## Diffusion Models | Model | Activation Rule | Key Property | |-------|----------------|--------------| | **Linear Threshold** | $\sum_{j \in N(i)} w_{ji} \geq \theta_i$ | Deterministic spread | | **Independent Cascade** | Each edge activates with prob p | Stochastic spread | | **Voter Model** | Copy random neighbor | Consensus formation | | **DeGroot Model** | $x_i(t+1) = \sum_j W_{ij}x_j(t)$ | Opinion averaging | ## Important Algorithms ### Shortest Path Algorithms | Algorithm | Time Complexity | Use Case | |-----------|-----------------|----------| | **BFS** | O(V + E) | Unweighted graphs | | **Dijkstra** | O((V + E) log V) | Non-negative weights | | **Bellman-Ford** | O(VE) | Negative weights | | **Floyd-Warshall** | O(V³) | All pairs | ### Community Detection | Algorithm | Time Complexity | Method | |-----------|-----------------|---------| | **Girvan-Newman** | O(m²n) | Edge betweenness | | **Louvain** | O(n log n) | Modularity optimization | | **Label Propagation** | O(m + n) | Label spreading | | **Infomap** | O(m) | Information flow | | **Spectral** | O(n²) | Eigenvalue decomposition | ## Network Properties Reference ### Small World Networks - High clustering: C >> C_random - Short paths: L ~ log(N) - Examples: Social networks, brain networks ### Scale-Free Networks - Power-law degree: P(k) ~ k^(-γ), γ ∈ [2,3] - Hubs present: k_max ~ N^(1/(γ-1)) - Robust to random failure, vulnerable to targeted attack ### Network Types Comparison | Type | Degree Dist | Clustering | Path Length | Example | |------|-------------|------------|-------------|---------| | **Regular** | Delta function | High | Long ~ N | Lattice | | **Random** | Poisson | Low ~ 1/N | Short ~ log N | ER model | | **Small World** | Peaked | High | Short ~ log N | Social | | **Scale-Free** | Power law | Variable | Ultra-short | Internet | ## Key Relationships 1. **Friendship Paradox**: $\langle k_{nn} \rangle \geq \langle k \rangle$ (neighbors have more friends) 2. **Degree Correlation**: $r = \frac{\langle jk \rangle_{jk} - \langle k \rangle^2}{\langle k^2 \rangle - \langle k \rangle^2}$ 3. **Percolation**: Giant component emerges at $p_c = 1/\langle k \rangle$ 4. **Influence**: Submodular function for influence maximization 5. **Homophily**: $E_{same} / E_{total} > random$ expectation ##
